references.text: Continues the instructions about leprosy and that the sick person must be brought to the priest for examination
Describes the priest's role in examining the leper when he is to be cleansed
Miriam was struck with leprosy, and Aaron asked Moses to pray for her
Reminder to follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy
Elisha heals Naaman from leprosy and demonstrates the prophet's authority in such matters
Jesus heals a leper and sends him to the priest as a testimony, in accordance with the Law of Moses
Jesus heals a leper man and commands him to show himself to the priest and offer sacrifices as Moses commanded
Jesus heals ten lepers and sends them to the priests to be declared clean
